events.label: PWHL 2026-27 season schedule and playoff format announcement

slots.name: regular-season games
slots.sentence: The PWHL unveiled major adaptations on Friday in releasing its 180-game regular-season schedule running from Dec. 5 to April 18, and includes the league’s previously announced first All-Star event on March 7.

slots.name: Takeover outings
slots.sentence: The PWHL’s popular “Takeover Tour” series is back and expanding from 16 to 24 outings, with the neutral site locations yet to be revealed.

slots.name: league teams
slots.sentence: The 180 games — with each team playing 30 — is up from 120 last season as a result of the PWHL growing to 12 teams with the addition of expansion franchises in Detroit, Las Vegas, San Jose and Hamilton, Ontario.

slots.name: games per team
slots.sentence: The 180 games — with each team playing 30 — is up from 120 last season

slots.name: expansion teams
slots.sentence: The Professional Women’s Hockey League’s addition of four new teams is translating into more games, an expanded playoff format and the introduction of two six-team conferences entering its fourth season.
